dedupe_keys.name: bts building timeseries dataset three australian buildings brick metadata

description: The Building TimeSeries (BTS) dataset covers three buildings over three years, with more than ten thousand time series and hundreds of unique Brick classes, and standardises the building metadata as a knowledge graph in the Brick schema. The buildings are anonymised but located in Canberra, Newcastle (New South Wales) and Melbourne; the dataset was presented at the NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks track with benchmarks for time series ontology classification and zero-shot forecasting, and is part of the NSW Digital Infrastructure Energy Flexibility (DIEF) project. A three-week snippet of 50 series and a Brick model are in the GitHub repository, and the full raw data, about 19 GB, are on Figshare (version 3, April 2025). Coverage: three buildings in Australia. Access: open download. Licence: CC BY 4.0 for data, MIT for code. Caveats: only three buildings, which are anonymised, and point naming follows each building's systems. Simulation uses are building operation time series and semantic metadata for digital twins, fault detection and forecasting models. Related records: the ASHRAE 223P semantic model data and Building Data Genome 2.
